commands.name: review-sidebar
commands.output: Review sidebar opened. Run /review-comments to load a PR.

tools.name: review_threads
tools.description: The unresolved review threads of the PR in the review sidebar, numbered as the sidebar shows them, with each thread's comments verbatim. Loads the PR when none is loaded, or when `pr` names another; `refresh` re-reads GitHub.

tools.name: review_triage
tools.description: Record your triage of review threads so the sidebar groups them and shows your suggestion. One item per thread, by its number.

tools.name: review_mark
tools.description: Record what happened to a review thread. `fixed-locally` once the change is made but not yet pushed; `fixed` only after the push, the reply and the resolve; `pushed-back` after the reply is posted. On `fixed` and `pushed-back` the sidebar re-reads GitHub.

tools.name: shutdown_sessions
tools.description: Lists this session and the other Claude sessions on this machine for /shutdown, and opens the shutdown pane where the user ticks which ones write a handoff. Says whether the pane is shown; when it is, the user sends from there and replies are tallied there.

tools.name: shutdown_send
tools.description: Sends the handoff request to the named sessions, as shutdown_sessions listed them; "this session" runs the handoff here too. Use only when the shutdown pane is not shown and the user picked in chat.

tools.name: restore_sessions
tools.description: Finds the Claude sessions active in a recent window from their transcripts, has Haiku judge which were mid-work, and opens the restore pane where the user ticks which to reopen. Says whether the pane is shown; when it is, the user reopens from there.

tools.name: restore_reopen
tools.description: Reopens the given sessions, by the ids restore_sessions returned, each in a new Windows Terminal tab with `claude --resume`. Use only when the restore pane is not shown and the user picked in chat.

tools.name: findings_start
tools.description: Starts an /ext-review or /self-review: loads the PR and its diff, clears the last round, and opens the findings pane. Claude's /code-review findings then reach the pane by themselves; record the other reviewers' with findings_record.

tools.name: findings_record
tools.description: Adds one reviewer's findings to the findings pane. Call once per reviewer when it finishes, with an empty list when it found nothing, so the pane stops waiting on it.

tools.name: findings_post
tools.description: Posts findings to the PR as one GitHub review under the user's name: inline where the diff shows the line, in the review body otherwise. A `note` leads the comment, e.g. what a fix changed. Post only what the user chose.

tools.name: findings_mark
tools.description: Records what happened to findings: `fixed` once the change is made; `dismissed` only when the user rejects it, which counts against its Clean Code rule; `withdrawn` when you find it does not hold up, which does not.
